title: July 2026 JOLTS Report: Little Changed. Again.
discussion_signal: The post reads low openings, hiring, quits, and layoffs as a persistent low-churn labor market, while warning that AI exposure is a map of changing work rather than a forecast of job losses. The discussion adds a public interpretation layer to the distinction between posted opportunity and actual worker mobility.
linked_research_question: When labor-market mobility cools, how do workers and employers experience the difference between nominal openings, actual hiring, and the ability to move?
limits: The post is an expert interpretation, not an independent survey of workers
JOLTS aggregates do not identify individual reasons for staying or moving
The AI-exposure interpretation is not a causal estimate
